entities.name: Melisk
entities.description: Orzhov attendant to Teysa Karlov who secretly served the Obzedat and manipulated Teysa.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Orzhov baroness whom Melisk served and manipulated.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: Orzhov ghost council Melisk secretly served.

entities.name: Taj
entities.description: Killers who possessed dead Gruul bodies and obeyed Melisk until Teysa took control.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: Guild whose dead bodies were possessed.

events.summary: Melisk uses narcolepsy spells to make Teysa a puppet in service of the Obzedat.
events.quote: Teysa became a puppet in his hands

events.summary: Melisk arranges the attack at the Karlov lokopede, in which his taj make Teysa kill her uncle.
Teysa learns of his treachery; Melisk brings his taj to kill her, but she takes control of them and he is dismembered and killed.

relations.quote: Melisk was an agent of the Obzedat
Melisk was a member of the Orzhov guild
